class.name: LocalizationServer
class.brief_description: Base class of the localization servers: catalog layers, locale chains per channel and catalog manifests.
class.description:
[LocalizationServer] is the abstract base of [TextLocalizationServer] (texts) and [ResourceLocalizationServer] (localized resource paths). It holds [LocalizationCatalog]s as layers with a priority, one key index over all layers and the data of the active locale chains. [b]Locale:[/b] the locale is stored in [TranslationServer], per channel: [method TranslationServer.set_locale] sets the general locale, [method TranslationServer.set_locale_for] the locale of a channel ([code]interface[/code], [code]audio[/code], [code]subtitles[/code] or a custom one). Every key follows the [member LocalizationCatalog.channel] of the highest-priority catalog that has it. The servers listen to [signal TranslationServer.locale_changed]: a change of one channel rebuilds only the keys of that channel, before the nodes re-translate. [b]Locale chain:[/b] a key is looked up for the locale, its parent locales, the closest other locale of the catalogs and then the fallback locale, for example [code]de_DE[/code] → [code]de[/code] → [code]de_AT[/code] → [code]en[/code] (see [method get_locale_chain]). Texts, resources and [LanguageSettingsServer] use the same rule. [b]Priority:[/b] the chain comes first (a text for [code]de_DE[/code] beats a text for [code]de[/code]), then the layers: the catalog with the higher priority wins; with equal priority, the catalog added later wins (the same rule as [member TextInsertionValues.priority]). [b]On-demand locales:[/b] catalogs loaded from [code].lcat[/code] files read a locale only when it is needed. The server reads the locales of the active chains and unloads the other locales of file-backed catalogs on a locale change. [b]Project catalogs:[/b] [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/localization/catalog_manifests] lists [FilesManifest]s; the list order is the priority, the [member FilesManifest.type_hint] names the catalog kind. They are loaded at startup (see [method load_project_catalogs]) and again when a watched manifest reports a new or removed file or a pack is mounted or unmounted. [b]Threads:[/b] reading is lock-free. Changes of catalogs and locales are applied on the main thread; calls from other threads are deferred. Signals are emitted on the main thread. [codeblocks] [gdscript] TranslationServer.set_locale("de_DE") print(TextLocalizationServer.get_locale_chain("de_DE")) # ["de_DE", "de", "en"]
var mods = FilesManifest.new() mods.folder_paths = ["user://mods/*/translations"] TextLocalizationServer.add_catalog_manifest(mods, 100) [/gdscript] [csharp] TranslationServer.SetLocale("de_DE"); // Methods of this base class are reached through the singleton instance in C#. GD.Print(TextLocalizationServer.Singleton.GetLocaleChain("de_DE")); // ["de_DE", "de", "en"]
var mods = new FilesManifest(); mods.FolderPaths = ["user://mods/*/translations"]; TextLocalizationServer.Singleton.AddCatalogManifest(mods, 100); [/csharp] [/codeblocks]

method.name: add_catalog
method.description: Adds [param catalog] as a layer with [param priority]. A catalog that was already added moves to the new priority. The catalog must be of the class this server takes ([TextLocalizationCatalog] for [TextLocalizationServer]). Changes of the catalog's content are picked up on the next idle frame. Emits [signal catalogs_changed].

method.name: add_catalog_manifest
method.description: Loads the catalog files of [param manifest] in its load order and adds them with [param priority]; returns the number of catalogs added. The [member FilesManifest.type_hint] names the catalog kind ([code skip-lint]TextLocalizationCatalog[/code] when empty, or [code skip-lint]ResourceLocalizationCatalog[/code]) and must be this server's; it is not used as a file filter. Without [member FilesManifest.extensions], the catalog formats are listed ([method LocalizationCatalog.get_file_extensions], [code].tres[/code], [code].res[/code]). Folders may hold wildcards, for example [code]user://mods/*/translations[/code]. Files are loaded with [ResourceLoader] (cached under their path). Main thread only.

method.name: clear_catalogs
method.description: Removes all catalogs. Key ids returned by [method TextLocalizationServer.get_key_id] stay valid. Emits [signal catalogs_changed].

method.name: get_available_locales
method.description: Returns the locales of all catalogs, each once, for example to fill a language menu.

method.name: get_available_locales_for
method.description: Returns the locales of the catalogs that give keys of the locale [param channel] (see [member LocalizationCatalog.channel] and [method TranslationServer.set_locale_for]), each once, in the order of the catalogs. A key counts for the channel of the highest-priority catalog that has it, and every catalog with that key serves the channel. Returns an empty array if no catalog has keys of [param channel], for example [code]"audio"[/code] in [TextLocalizationServer]. [method LanguageSettingsServer.get_available_locales_for] combines the locales of all localization servers.

method.name: get_catalogs
method.description: Returns the catalogs, the lowest priority first.

method.name: get_key_count
method.description: Returns the number of keys (rows) the server knows. Rows are never removed while the server runs, so this also counts keys of removed catalogs.

method.name: get_locale_chain
method.description: Returns the locales a key is looked up in, in order: the standardized [param locale], its parent locales, the closest other locale of this server's catalogs by [method TranslationServer.compare_locales], then the fallback locale and its parents, each once. For example [code]"de_DE"[/code] gives [code]["de_DE", "de", "de_AT", "en"][/code] with catalogs for [code]de_AT[/code] and the fallback locale [code]en[/code].

method.name: load_project_catalogs
method.description: Loads the catalogs of the manifests in [member ProjectSettings.internationalization/localization/catalog_manifests] whose kind is this server's, with priority 0 in list order (a later manifest wins), and returns the number of catalogs. The catalogs of the previous call are replaced, so calling it again does not add layers twice. [ResourceLocalizationServer] adds the project's [code]internationalization/locale/translation_remaps[/code] as the first layer. Each manifest is registered in [FilesManifestServer] as [code]localization_catalogs_<index>[/code]: when it is watched ([method FilesManifestServer.set_watching]), new or removed files reload the catalogs, as do packs mounted or unmounted by [PCKPackageServer]. The engine calls it at startup.

method.name: remove_catalog
method.description: Removes [param catalog]. Its keys keep their ids but have no text from it anymore. Emits [signal catalogs_changed].

signal.name: catalogs_changed
signal.description: Emitted after catalogs were added or removed, or after the content of a catalog changed, once the server's data was rebuilt.

signal.name: locale_loaded
signal.description: Emitted when the texts of [param locale] became available: when it joins the active locale chain and a catalog has it.
